data.title: Beach Oasis 2
data.about:
Beach Oasis 2 by Azizi Developments in Studio City offers a unique blend of modern design and luxury amenities, creating the perfect environment for contemporary living. This low-rise development features studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed with modern interiors that blend style and comfort. The apartments are perfect for individuals and families alike, providing a serene and sophisticated living space that caters to a variety of lifestyle needs.

At the heart of Beach Oasis 2 By Azizi Developments for sale lies a stunning lagoon-style swimming pool, offering a refreshing escape amidst the bustling city. The beautifully landscaped green areas surrounding the pool create a tranquil oasis where residents can unwind and enjoy nature. Whether it's a morning jog through the gardens or an evening swim, Beach Oasis Phase 2 provides a perfect balance of relaxation and recreation.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• The floor plans of Azizi Beach Oasis 2 include studio to 2-bedroom apartments
  • Azizi Beach Oasis 2 features a lagoon-style pool 
  • The units boast modern interiors and finishes.
  • The apartments offer an active lifestyle with easy access to golf clubs, restaurants and other attractions.
  • Its vibrant environment and convenient location attract both young professionals and families.

location_tile.title: Beach Oasis 2: Discover Leisure and Luxury in the Heart of the City.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Enjoy an ideal location offering proximity to various lifestyle amenities. Beach Oasis 2 is located in Dubai Studio City, where residents enjoy proximity to various landmarks and attractions, like Dubai Autodrome, Dubai Miracle Garden,  Dubai Butterfly Garden, and Arabian Ranches Golf Club.
Located along Al Qudra Road (D63), the community is easily accessible through other city areas.


2 Minutes to Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club
3 Minutes to Dubai Autodrome
3 Minutes to Sheikh Zayed Road
18 Minutes to Dubai Marina
18 Minutes to Expo City

seo.metaTitle: Azizi Beach Oasis 2 at Dubai Studio City
seo.metaDescription: Experience modern living in a dynamic development Azizi Beach Oasis 2 at Dubai Studio City. The low-rise project offers studio to 2-bedroom apartments.

more_info.answer: Azizi Beach Oasis 2 features modern interiors, spacious layouts, and high-quality finishes across all its studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. The development is designed to provide a comfortable and stylish living environment, catering to diverse lifestyle needs.
more_info.question: What are the key features of Azizi Beach Oasis 2?

more_info.answer: Beach Oasis 2 amenities include a central lagoon-style swimming pool, beautifully landscaped green areas, state-of-the-art gymnasium halls, a vibrant courtyard with cafes and restaurants, children's play areas, and 24/7 security services, ensuring a complete and luxurious living experience.
more_info.question: What amenities are available at Beach Oasis 2?

more_info.answer: Azizi Beach Oasis 2 is strategically located in Dubai Studio City, providing residents with easy access to key landmarks, entertainment venues, and major roadways. Its prime location makes it an ideal choice for those seeking a modern lifestyle in a vibrant community.
